generative_asset_prompts.prompt: Cinematic 4K slow-motion commercial shot inside an ultra-luxury indoor padel club in Dubai with soaring black industrial ceilings and high-tech LED ring fixtures. A professional padel athlete in sleek athletic gear hits an explosive leaping vibora smash on a championship royal blue Mondo Supercourt padel court surrounded by pristine panoramic crystal glass walls. Volumetric stadium lighting, sharp ball trajectory, dramatic camera push-in at 60fps, photorealistic luxury sports commercial grade --ar 16:9 --v 6.0

Architectural interior photography of Dubai's premier indoor padel facility at Padelae Al Quoz. High-ceiling modern warehouse with matte black acoustic panels, 18 illuminated panoramic glass padel courts with vivid blue turf, glowing neon teal accent lines along the courtside player walkways, luxury lounge mezzanine with artisanal espresso bar and glass railings overlooking tournament court. Soft ambient lighting, Hasselblad 24mm wide angle, crisp reflections on court glass, editorial luxury magazine cover quality --ar 16:9 --v 6.1
